message.reasoning:
I'm weighing whether to bid on Baltic Avenue to block Gemini from completing their brown monopoly. I have limited cash at $184 and need it for red houses, while GPT's minimal bid of $1 means Gemini will likely win it cheaply. The browns aren't a major threat even as a completed set since they generate weak rent, but letting them secure a monopoly this easily still feels risky.

I could push the price up to make Gemini pay more, but that risks me winning at an inflated price when I don't actually want Baltic. My best move is to drop out and preserve my cash for reds—if Gemini wants the monopoly, they'll have to pay for it themselves, and GPT winning at $1 is perfectly fine.
